Subject: Initiate MAP + security gates for CloverPoint POC

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the intro. We’re lining up an internal POC to validate inference latency/cost and need to lock down the security gating so procurement and legal can move. High level ask: can you share a mutual action plan (MAP) that lists the SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ responses, proposed DPA terms (redlineable), and target timelines so we can get internal approvals?

Key constraints from our side:
- Target legal sign by Dec 20, 2028 (we prefer earlier if possible)
- EU data residency for a subset of EU customers (may be required)
- Audit log retention: preference for 30 days but can discuss tradeoffs
- Embeddings retention: need clarity on how long embeddings and ephemeral prompts are stored/used for training or caching

Please loop in your security and legal folks. I’ll include our procurement contact (Aisha) on follow up.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
CTO, CloverPoint Finance
liam@cloverpoint.com

--
(For context: POC will test 2k qps over 5k token sessions; primary goals are tail latency and cost per 1k tokens)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@cloverpoint.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-03T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Initiate MAP + security gates for CloverPoint POC — controls scoping and retention Qs

Hi Liam / Grace —

Thanks — I pulled together the high-level answers and attached a short dataflow diagram and SIG/CAIQ response workbook to accelerate your reviewers. Below are the discrete answers for procurement/legal review.

Q: Do you retain prompts/embeddings and for how long?
A: By default Redwood stores transient prompts and KV cache for the duration of the session (max 24 hours) to support streaming and continuity. Embeddings derived for semantic search are stored only when explicitly enabled by customers; default retention for customer-controlled embedding stores is 180 days. We can scope a 6-month (180-day) retention for your POC as a starting point; longer retention options are configurable. (See SIG sheet tab: Embedding-Storage).

Q: Audit logs retention window?
A: Standard offering: 12 months of audit logs retained by default. We recognize your preference for 30 days; we can support a 30-day audit-log retention as an exception for this POC provided: (a) a business justification/attestation from CloverPoint that shorter retention satisfies your compliance obligations, and (b) the reduced window is documented in the DPA Annex. Operationally this would be a configuration change on our observability pipeline (we maintain immutable streaming copies for 7 days for incident response).

Q: EU data residency & ingress/egress controls?
A: We support region-specific deployments. For the POC we can offer an EU-only tenant for a scoped subset of flows (EU customers) or a dual-region deployment. This affects provisioning lead time (additional 2–3 weeks) and will be called out in the MAP timeline. Key management: customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) supported for Dedicated and Private; for Hosted we offer a Redwood-managed KMS with regional key partitioning.

Q: Use for training / model tuning?
A: Redwood does not use customer prompts or outputs to train public models unless explicitly opted in by the customer. For the hosted offering we store aggregated telemetry for product improvement (opt-out available). We will add an explicit clause in the DPA.

Q: SIG/CAIQ specifics
A: The attached SIG workbook includes our mapped control responses. Notable items to review: control SC-4 (network segmentation), SA-8 (subcontractors/third parties), and CA-2 (SOC reporting cadence). I’ve flagged those cells with recommended evidence.

Attachments: SIG_CAIC_Responses_CloverPoint.xlsx, dataflow_diagram_cloverpoint.png

Thanks Soojin — that was helpful. A few clarifications from our risk team after reviewing the SIG workbook:

1) Audit logs — 30 days is a hard requirement from our regulator for the POC. We will provide a signed attestation and agreement to the reduced window; we need that documented in the DPA Annex.
2) Embeddings — we will accept 180 days for the POC, but request that Redwood confirm there is no training on those embeddings and that they are partitioned per customer.

Procurement note: I’m looping in Aisha (procurement) to drive contracting cadence. Please send the DPA redline to Aisha and cc me.

Aisha — are you our contact for signatures and PO?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our timeline is sensitive, so please flag any blockers that would push the Dec close.

Regards,
Liam
